description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for handling email notifications related to leave requests, such as retrieving subscribers, employees with specific roles, supervisors, leave details, and comments. The class uses traits for user role management and date/time helpers and interacts with various entities and services to facilitate email processing workflows for leave management.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing email processing functionalities for leave requests, including subscriber retrieval, employee role identification, supervisor notification, leave details formatting, and comment retrieval.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LeaveRequestCommentService instance used for retrieving leave request comments.

methods.name: getSubscribersForEvent
methods.description: Retrieves email subscribers associated with a specific event notification ID.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Fetches employees holding a specific role, filtered by an employee instance.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the recipient information for the employee itself, if they have a work email.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves recipients based on email notification type, mapped from predefined notification constants.

methods.name: getSupervisors
methods.description: Fetches the supervisor recipients for a given employee.

methods.name: getLeaveDetailsByDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Formats detailed leave information into a list suitable for email content, including date, time, duration, and half-day indication.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Retrieves and formats comments associated with a specific leave request ID.
